# Rukaiya Binta Hossain Ekra (Dear Ekra)

> Rukaiya Binta Hossain Ekra, known as Dear Ekra, is a content creator and brand promoter in Bangladesh. She creates promotional reels, product reviews, food, beauty, fashion, destination and resort, and campus-life content for Bangladeshi brands and local businesses, including professional video editing.

Canonical name: Rukaiya Binta Hossain Ekra (alternate spelling: Ruqaiya Binte Hossain Ekra). Brand name: Dear Ekra / DearEkra.
Portfolio: https://mydearekra.pages.dev/

## Services

- Beauty & Skincare PR
- Launch & Grand Opening Promotion, Food Experience Reviews
- Fashion Styling & Collection Showcase, Brand Product Review
- Destination & Resort Marketing, Travel Review Content
- Personal Vlogs & Campus Life
- Professional Video Editing

Work is based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Content is published in Bangla and English.
